verdict.rationale: Scheduled automation is a fair question for a game engine and its tooling, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents no recurring scheduling capability. Unreal Automation Tool, Python editor scripting and the Tasks System cover one-off or on-demand automation, async job execution, and delegates that call a function 'at a future time'. These are building blocks or adjacent features, not a recurring job schedule. Smoke tests running at every editor start are a startup hook, not a schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
